environment.description: Provider executes within an EKS pod behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer). The NLB target group has a listener on port 9187 with an associated VPC security group that permits inbound TCP/9187 only from CIDR 10.200.44.0/30 (the Terraform Cloud agent runner subnet, 2 usable IPs). Additionally, a Cilium L3/L4 network policy (CiliumNetworkPolicy kind with endpointSelector matching label app=terraform-provider-acme) restricts ingress to port 9187 from pods with label role=tfc-agent only. The EKS node security group has no additional inbound rules for 9187. The pod runs with a non-root securityContext (runAsUser: 65534) and readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, preventing the /tmp state dump from succeeding.

config.cilium_policy: CiliumNetworkPolicy ingress fromEndpoints matchLabels role=tfc-agent toPort 9187
